help.faq1_q: How do I collect my winnings?
help.faq1_a: Present your original receipt at a participating seller. Winnings are verified from the public code printed on the receipt.
help.faq2_a: New York and Florida draws follow the officially published schedules. Check the Results section to see each session's real-time status.
help.faq3_a: A ticket can be pending during draw validation. The status updates as soon as results are confirmed by official sources.
help.faq4_q: How do I verify a ticket?
help.faq4_a: Go to the Verification page and enter the public code at the bottom of your printed receipt. You can also scan the QR code.

operator.hero_title: Run lottery sales, terminals and draws from one place.
operator.hero_body: Tchalanet brings together mobile ticket sales, internal ticket scanning, draw and limit configuration, Maryaj gratis, terminal control and a global view of sales.
operator.benefits_body: Concrete tools to sell, configure, control and understand your network activity.
operator.benefit_agents_body: Create team access, control authorized terminals and track activity by location.
operator.benefit_tickets_body: Sell tickets from mobile with QR/public code and history tied to the seller.
operator.benefit_verify_body: Scan a ticket in the manager space to see its status and linked results.
operator.benefit_results_body: Configure draws, limits, available games and rules such as Maryaj gratis.
operator.benefit_payments_body: Keep a clear view of tickets sold, verified, cancelled or waiting for results.
operator.benefit_reports_body: Track global sales, terminal performance and the most played or sold numbers.
operator.step1_body: Define your draws, limits, games, rules and authorized sellers.
operator.step2_body: Sellers issue tickets from the mobile app.
operator.step3_body: Scan tickets internally or let customers verify with the public code.
operator.step4_body: Review sales, terminals, tickets and the most played numbers.
operator.plans_body: Choose the level of support suited to your network.
operator.plan_trial_body: Test Tchalanet with a few sellers before a full rollout.
operator.plan_essential_body: For a seller who wants a simple start.
operator.plan_network_body: For multiple sellers, across one or more locations.
operator.plan_operator_body: For an organization with advanced needs.
operator.access_title: Control who sells, where, and with which limits
operator.access_body: Each user only sees the features authorized by their role, terminal and active configuration.
operator.access_rights_body: Admin, supervisor or seller, depending on your needs.
operator.access_subscription_body: Every sale is tied to an authorized seller and terminal.
operator.access_plan_body: Games, draws, limits and rules are applied based on your configuration.
operator.form_body: Describe your business or network. We will get back to you with a tailored demonstration.
operator.form_message_placeholder: E.g. I have 3 sellers in Carrefour and I want to manage my daily draws.
operator.form_error: Unable to send the request. Check your information and try again.
operator.faq_trial_q: How does the trial period work?
operator.faq_trial_a: The trial period lets you test the app with a limited number of sellers, depending on the available plan.
operator.faq_verify_q: How do customers verify a ticket?
operator.faq_verify_a: Each ticket has a public code or QR allowing anyone to check its status without accessing the manager space.
operator.faq_expired_q: What happens if my access is suspended?
operator.faq_expired_a: Features are limited until regularized. Contact the team to reactivate your access.
operator.faq_multipos_q: Can I manage multiple sellers and terminals?
operator.faq_multipos_a: Yes. The Network and Custom plans let you configure multiple sellers, control their terminals and centralize reports.
operator.faq_mobile_q: Can my sellers use Tchalanet on mobile?
operator.faq_mobile_a: Yes. The Tchalanet POS app is available on mobile for authorized sellers.
operator.faq_seller-terminals_q: How many sellers can I use?
operator.faq_seller-terminals_a: Limits depend on the plan you choose. Contact us to find the setup that fits your network.

WINNING_PAYABLE.title: Winning ticket — payment to claim
WINNING_PAYABLE.body: This ticket has a prize. Present the original receipt to a participating seller to collect your winnings, following the instructions shown.

WINNING_PAID.title: Winning ticket — already paid
WINNING_PAID.body: This ticket has already been presented and paid. If you believe this is an error, contact Tchalanet customer support.

LOST.title: Non-winning ticket
LOST.body: This ticket does not show a prize based on the available results. Thank you for playing.

PENDING_RESULT.title: Ticket awaiting result
PENDING_RESULT.body: The ticket is recognised, but the draw result is not yet available. Check back after the draw.

CANCELLED.title: Cancelled ticket
CANCELLED.body: This ticket has been cancelled and cannot be paid. Contact the seller if you believe this is an error.

EXPIRED.title: Expired ticket
EXPIRED.body: The claim period for this ticket has passed. Tchalanet tickets must be presented within the allowed timeframe.

BLOCKED.title: Blocked ticket
BLOCKED.body: This ticket is temporarily blocked. Contact your seller or Tchalanet customer support for more information.

NOT_FOUND.title: Ticket not found
NOT_FOUND.body: Invalid or missing code. Check the code printed on your receipt and try again.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Service temporarily unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.body: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few moments.
